description: Somalia flooding Jilib, Saakow, and Bu'aale districts 2018 05 01 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Field Information Services Section (FISS). UNOSAT produced satellite-detected flood water extent in the districts of Jilib, Saakow, and Bu'aale, Somalia. The analysis was conducted analyzing Sentinel-1 images acquired on the 1 May 2018. As observed from the satellite imagery, a total of 92,000 ha of land were inundated in the area of interest. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Field Information Services Section (FISS). It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-09-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
